title: Files tab — pictures or a list — contract — acceptance

steps.path: The Files tab — its toolbar, the 'Project Files' line, and the files below
steps.headline: The contract, graded — accept these verdicts?

rows.statement: The Files tab has two ways to look: the picture grid you have today, and a compact list.
rows.evidence: FilesTab exports FileViewMode = 'grid' | 'list' and renders cards for one, rows for the other; files-tab-list-view.test.tsx 'draws cards, not rows, in grid view' plus the three list-row tests, 8/8 passing on feat/file-list-view.

rows.statement: The switch is on screen without opening any menu, and the view you are in is the marked one.
Each list row shows a small icon, the filename, its kind, and how long ago it changed.
rows.evidence: files-tab-list-view.test.tsx 'gives each file a name, a kind and a relative time' asserts notes.md / Document / matches ago|just now on one row; 'gives a folder its file count and no date' asserts the folder case. Passing.

rows.statement: The view you pick is remembered once for the whole app, so every project opens in it.
rows.evidence: files-tab-list-view.test.tsx 'is stored app-wide, not against a project id' asserts ProjectView holds a literal FILE_VIEW_KEY = 'youcoded.projectView.fileView' with no project id interpolated, written via localStorage.setItem(FILE_VIEW_KEY, fileView). Passing.

rows.statement: At phone width you keep the view you picked; neither view is forced on you.
The list gives one row per file, so a folder with many files is readable.
rows.evidence: Approved on the round-1 deck as F-2 (yes, no note), pictures filelist--midnight and filelist--halftone-dimension, before/after.

rows.statement: The search box keeps the shade it has today; only the tabs and the switch share theirs.
The switch sits small at the right end of the 'Project Files' line, off the toolbar.
rows.evidence: Chosen on the round-2 deck as R-2 ('beside'), against variant A on the toolbar; pictures place-a / place-b in both themes. Shipped in commit ba24798c.

rows.statement: At phone width the search box keeps its full width and the switch sits on the line below.
rows.evidence: Chosen on the round-2 deck as R-3 ('beside') at 390px; pictures phone-a / phone-b in both themes.
